bibl.title: A dance for a princess: The legends on a painting in room 5 of the Southwest Annex of the Monastery on Kom H in Dongola.
bibl.seg: Vincent W. J. van Gerven Oei, A dance for a princess: The legends on a painting in room 5 of the Southwest Annex of the Monastery on Kom H in Dongola.
bibl.note: Transcription, translation, and analysis of the Old Nubian legends on a painting of a dancing scene in room 5 of the Southwest Annex of the Monastery on Kom H in Dongola. - 1. The painting. - 2. The legends. - 3. Commentary: 3.1. Linguistic and palaeographical observations; - 3.2. The Virgin Mary; - 3.3. The location of the paintings; - 3.4. The nature of the dance. - 4. Conclusion.
